newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise, local blenders active.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise, local blenders active.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.

Brokers said local blenders were active in the bidding while buyers for Pakistan, Poland and Afghanistan remained mostly subdued, pushing the prices of quality teas down. The brokers, however, said the average tea prices were a little up because dust teas sold at higher rates at the aution.

Some 696,930 kgs of teas were sold at the auction. The average price was 50.01 taka per kg, 0.45 taka up from the previous sale. The next auction will be on January 7 with an expected offer of 985,000 kg. ($1 = 42.45 taka)
